# יהלום לבית · Yahalom La Bait

> Israeli boutique brand for luxury tempered-glass wall art and premium home pictures. Gallery-grade UV digital printing on extra-clear tempered glass, manufactured in Modi'in, Israel, with insured nationwide shipping and 5-year warranty.

Yahalom La Bait (יהלום לבית) designs and produces high-end glass art prints (תמונות זכוכית מחוסמת) for private homes across Israel. The catalog spans modern, abstract, nature, pop-art, fashion and Judaica / Kodesh collections, alongside a fully custom personal-print service. Every piece is printed on 6mm extra-clear tempered glass with a hidden hanging system, polished edges and optional professional in-home installation.
